To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
inflammatory cytokines augment TGF-beta-induced EMT by up-regulating Smad signaling.
cytomix, a mixture of IL-β, TNF-α and IFN-γ, significantly enhances TGF-β1-induced epithelial to mesenchymal transition through enhancing TβR-I and Smads signaling in A549 cells.
inflammatory cytokines augment TGF-beta-induced EMT by up-regulating the expression of TGF beta receptor type I.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of cytokine in the induction of EMT and the molecular mechanisms involved.
the mechanism of EMT in lung fibrosis and cancer.
the mechanism of inflammatory cytokines on TGF-beta1 induced epithelial mesenchymal transition and the role of TGF-beta1 receptor I on this process.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
inflammatory cytokines augment TGF-beta-induced EMT through up-regulation of TbetaR-1 and Smad signaling.
cytomix augumented TGF-beta1 induced EMT via up-regulation of TbetaR-1.
the inflammatory cytokine IL-1beta/TNF-alpha and TGF-beta1 can act synergistically to induce EMT and that this effect may be mediated via upregulation of TbetaR-1.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the cytomix, but not the individual cytokine, can significantly enhance TGF-beta1 induced EMT in A 549 cells by upregulating the expression of TGF beta receptor type 1 and Smad 2 and Smad 3, and the cytomix plus the TGF-beta1 can be more potent in inducing the EMT.
inflammatory cytokines, such as TNF-alpha and IL-1beta in the cytomix, augment TGF-beta-induced EMT by up-regulating Smad signaling via up-regulation of TbetaR-1.
cytomix enhances TGF-beta-induced EMT in part via up-regulating expression of TbetaR-1.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of TGF-beta1 and inflammatory cytokines is a more potent inducer of EMT.
the inflammatory cytokines IL-1beta (and to a lesser extent, TNF-alpha) and IFN-g promote EMT in A459 cells.
inflammatory cytokines can enhance EMT by upregulating expression of TbetaR-1.
